# Chromobench DSL reference

Globals: `cb`, `frame`, `units`, `mem`, `console`. Handles are lazy nodes: `await` a measurement for numbers. Options are literal values. Unset recipe-backed arguments come from the frame's recipe.

## Vocabulary

- `frame.source()` — the scan as decoded (camera-linear), the recipe's own node
- `frame.scan()` — scanner densities above the rebate (scanner-density)
- `frame.negative()` — the negative as dye amounts (film-dyes): what the enlarger prints
- `frame.print(opts?)` — the physical print under the viewing light (print-xyz); opts as neg.print
- `frame.display()` — what the viewer shows (display-rgb)
- `neg.print({ paper, time_s, fstop, filtration, lights, grade, preflash, illuminant, flare })` — a what-if print of a negative; unset options come from the recipe; changes nothing
- `frame.edit({ 'print.enlarger.time_s': 12.6 }, { why })` — proposes recipe changes; submitted together when the eval succeeds; returns a receipt with a preview
- `frame.edit.exposure.add({ id, kind, mask, stops }, { why }) / .remove(id)` — proposes a dodge, burn, flash or split exposure (a mask handle is stored with it)
- `frame.why('print.lights.logH')` — who set a recipe value, and when
- `cb.testStrip(frame, { vary: 'time', steps: 7, step: 1 / 3 })` — a test strip; its look carries one reading per band
- `cb.ringAround(frame, { step_cc: 10 })` — a 3×3 ring-around; its look carries one reading per cell
- `cb.compare([a, b], 'label')` — one side-by-side look; each half carries its own numbers
- `h.look('label' | { label, box, at, size })` — queues an image for you, with the numbers it shows (max 4 per eval)
- `units.pt(x) · toPt · stops · toStops · stopsFromTime(t1, t2) · stopsFromFstop(n1, n2)` — unit conversions; numbers or arrays

## Receiver-less ops

- `cb.darkroom.contactSheet({ frames, cell_px }) → print-xyz — A contact sheet of several frames.`
  - frames: string[], default [] — Frame ids.
  - cell_px: number, px, [64, 1024], default 256 — Cell size.
- `cb.source.open({ source, encoding }) → camera-linear — Opens a decoded source as linear sensor values (T = signal / flat after scan.flatField).`
  - source: string — SHA-256 of the source file (FrameRecipe.source.sha256); the engine must have opened it.
  - encoding: enum linear|srgb|gamma22, default "linear", recipe source.decode.encoding — Transfer encoding of the stored samples.

## Handles in camera-linear

- **mask**
  - `h.mask.ellipse({ box }) → mask — Elliptical mask.`
    - box: box, px, default {"x":0,"y":0,"w":16,"h":16} — Bounding box in source px.
  - `h.mask.gradient({ from, to }) → mask — Linear gradient mask (graduated burn).`
    - from: point, px, default {"x":0,"y":0} — Where the mask is 1 (source px).
    - to: point, px, default {"x":0,"y":100} — Where the mask is 0 (source px).
  - `h.mask.luminance({ above, below, softness }) → mask — Mask from a luminance range of the receiver.`
    - above: number, fraction, [0, 1], default 0 — Select values above this (normalised to the domain range).
    - below: number, fraction, [0, 1], default 1 — Select values below this.
    - softness: number, fraction, [0, 0.5], default 0.05 — Transition width.
  - `h.mask.paint({ strokes }) → mask — Painted mask.`
    - strokes: string, default "none" — Id of a stroke set stored with mask.set.
- **measure**
  - `h.measure.histogram({ channel, bins }) → value — Histogram over the domain range.`
    - channel: enum r|g|b|L, default "L" — Channel (L = mean of channels).
    - bins: number, [8, 1024], default 64 — Number of bins.
    - returns `edges`, `counts`
  - `h.measure.patches({ box, cols, rows }) → value — Mean value per grid cell (test strips, ring-arounds, charts).`
    - box: box, px, optional — Region; absent = whole image.
    - cols: number, [1, 24], default 1 — Columns.
    - rows: number, [1, 24], default 1 — Rows.
    - returns `cells`
  - `h.measure.stats({ box, mask }) → value — Exact statistics over a region.`
    - box: box, px, optional — Region in source px; absent = whole image.
    - mask: Mask, optional — Weighting mask.
    - returns `mean`, `p01`, `p99`, `clipLow`, `clipHigh`
- **scan**
  - `h.scan.density({ rebate }) → scanner-density — Scanner density relative to the rebate: d = −log10(T / T_rebate).`
    - rebate: box, px, optional, recipe scan.rebate — Box in source (sensor) pixels; absent means automatic.
  - `h.scan.flare({ flare }) → camera-linear — Removes scanner flare.`
    - flare: number, percent, [0, 20], default 0, recipe scan.flare — Scanner veiling flare, percent of the open-gate signal.
  - `h.scan.flatField({ flat }) → camera-linear — Divides by the flat field in sensor coordinates.`
    - flat: string, optional, recipe scan.flat — SHA-256 of the flat-field frame (opened like a source).
  - `h.scan.noise({ box }) → value — Measures noise σ per channel (MAD), in density.`
    - box: box, px, optional — Region; absent = whole frame.
    - returns `sigma`
  - `h.scan.rebate({ rebate }) → value — Measures the rebate (unexposed base) transmittance.`
    - rebate: box, px, optional, recipe scan.rebate — Box in source (sensor) pixels; absent means automatic.
    - returns `T`, `box`
- **source**
  - `h.source.info({  }) → value — Facts about the decoded source.`
    - returns `width`, `height`, `bits`, `encoding`, `sha256`
  - `h.source.xyz({ mode, temperature_K, tint }) → scene-xyz — Photo mode: camera RGB to scene XYZ with the camera matrices in SourceInfo.camera (consumed by CHB-012).`
    - mode: enum daylight|as-shot|custom, default "daylight", recipe capture.whiteBalance.mode — White balance source.
    - temperature_K: number, K, [2000, 15000], default 5500, recipe capture.whiteBalance.temperature_K — Custom white balance temperature.
    - tint: number, [-150, 150], default 0, recipe capture.whiteBalance.tint — Custom white balance tint (green–magenta).
- **view**
  - `h.view.inspect({ mode }) → display-rgb — Renders an intermediate domain for inspection (negative, dye, class views) as display RGB.`
    - mode: enum negative|density|dyes|classes|mask, default "negative" — Inspection view.
